name: Balak
summary: The king of Moab who feared Israel and sent for Balaam to curse them. Each time, Balaam blessed Israel instead.

key_moments.title: Sending for Balaam
key_moments.description: Seeing what Israel had done to the Amorites, Balak and Moab were terrified. He sent messengers to Balaam, asking him to come and curse this people who were too strong for him.

key_moments.title: Takes Balaam Up to Curse Israel
key_moments.description: Balak took Balaam up to Baal's high places and built seven altars as Balaam asked. But Balaam blessed Israel, and Balak complained that he had brought him to curse his enemies.

key_moments.title: Sends Balaam Away in Anger
key_moments.description: Balak clapped his hands in anger, because Balaam had blessed Israel three times. He sent Balaam home without the honor he had hoped to give him.
